notes: Εἰ is left unrepresented as an interrogative marker; aligning it to the auxiliary 'Did' remains defensible, but rule 9 already gives that auxiliary to ἐλάβετε.
οὐδέ keeps the whole 'not so much as' as one aligned unit rather than splitting the idiom across the negation.
ἔστιν → 'was given' is headed on the supplied 'given' under rule 17's support-verb clause and its own 'was given' example; a head on 'was', as the word directly realizing εἰμί, remains defensible.
The supplied lexical verb of the verbless clause οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν rides with πρός and is headed on 'unto' (rule 62).
